honest_c3.text: Recursive evidence at level_1 within anima-core and anima-hexad is INFERRED from filesystem layout, not declared via explicit core/module/doc subdir naming (singular convention from mk2_apex section 2.5 canonical_layout). The current anima FS uses anima-core/{runtime,verification,lib} not core/module/doc. Recursion exists at the abstraction-implementation-doc semantic level, not at the literal-subdir-name level.

Inner anima/anima/{core,modules,spec,state} IS the only place where literal core/+modules/ subdir naming appears — this is the strongest direct evidence. But it uses plural 'modules' (mk1 type-grouped layout) not singular 'module' (mk2 canonical_layout). So even the explicit case is mk1-shape, not mk2-shape.

T1/T2/T3 ↔ core/moduler/ai-native alignment is a CONJECTURE not a theorem. T1/T2/T3 partitions by user audience (external/internal/identity), while core/moduler/ai-native partitions by abstraction-direction (contract/impl/cold-read-doc). These are orthogonal axes. Each tier separately exhibits the triplet recursion — that is the actual finding, not 'T1=core, T2=moduler, T3=ai-native'.

anima identity = PureField + Hexad + repulsion + emergence is asserted in ω-cycle docs but NO explicit anima-core/repulsion.hexa exists (find returned 0 hits). Repulsion is a conceptual claim distributed across multiple modules (consciousness templates, paradigm v11) without canonical core file. references 'PureField repulsion' as anima identity but the substrate is documentary not file-canonical.

ai_native_module_architecture spec adoption status = 'partial' for anima (per spec consumers field): 17 README.ai.md baseline grandfathered + only modules/rng prototype fully conformant. So 'anima ai-native layer' as a coherent layer is PARTIALLY-realized policy, not fully-deployed reality. own entries 14/15/16/17 strengthen the policy but FS-level conformance lags.

mk2_apex section 2.5 canonical_layout.recursive_case explicitly declares unbounded recursion 'practically capped at 2-3 levels by feature granularity'. This is the only place where recursion is FORMALLY a property of the spec. Therefore 'core/moduler/ai-native is recursive' at the spec layer = TRUE-by-declaration. Whether anima FS realizes that recursion in practice = PARTIAL-true (see C1, C2).
